refreeze.reason: Revision 1 used ARKitScenes 3DOD meshes as reference geometry. Before acquiring any selected scene or inspecting any outcome, the study was upgraded to CA-1M captures that provide FARO laser-scanner registered GT depth and poses. This makes the sensor-error target independent of the onboard ARKit depth being calibrated.

source.groundTruth: Per-frame FARO laser-scanner rendered depth registered to the capture camera
source.selectionPolicy: Choose three CA-1M train captures and five CA-1M val captures that also appear in ARKitScenes metadata with distinct visit IDs. Freeze membership before downloading any selected tar or inspecting any metric outcome.

rules.selectionRule: Selected scenes remain in the ledger even if difficult, missing frames, poorly calibrated, or negative. Replacement requires a new explicit split revision and invalidates any previously inspected outcome.

note: Revision 2 is the first evidence-eligible split. Revision 1 was superseded before any selected public scene was downloaded or evaluated because its reference mesh was not independent enough for LiDAR error calibration.
